summary: Frontend verification of the new Koollite Lighting Intelligence Dual-Path Upgrade Strategy. Verified the new /koollite/roi page (+ aliases /koollite, /roi, /lighting/roi), live dual-path ROI calculator (inputs drive both result-a and result-b), the 4 preset chooser (supermarket / airport / school / warehouse) with key-based remount, HomePage home-koollite-dual-path-section, /lighting lighting-dual-path-section, SchoolDistrictDemoPage Koollite scene (Option A + Option B + CTA linking to /koollite/roi), SupermarketDemoPage scene 14 Self-Funding strip (supermarket-koollite-strip / supermarket-koollite-dualpath). Airport demo's dual-path strip is wired in code (AirportDemoPage lines 1316-1319) but automation could not drive past the audio-prefetch Start-Demo gate to scene 6 in the available time — code review confirms the testids exist at the right location; the strip is rendered after ImpactTiles in scene 'lifecycle'. Proposal-dual-path-summary flow was not exercised end-to-end (requires real email + proposal generation API) but the component is present in LightingUpgradeEnginePage at lines 682-725 with all required testids.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Source: /app/frontend/src/pages/LightingUpgradeEnginePage.jsx line 290. Non-blocking but should be fixed — remove any nested <span> inside <option> children, options can only contain text.

action_items: Fix the React hydration warning in LightingUpgradeEnginePage.jsx around line 290 — remove wrapping <span> inside <option> in the 'Term (months)' Select. This shows on every /lighting load in the console.
Optional: consider exposing a uniform data-testid='scene-jump' on AirportDemoPage (currently uses airport-control-jump) for consistency across demos — SupermarketDemoPage already uses 'scene-jump'.
critical_code_review_comments: KoolliteDualPath.jsx (607 lines) is getting long; consider splitting PathCard / Field / calcDualPath into a sub-file for maintainability.

Airport demo requires audio prefetch to complete before Start Demo is enabled — can block automation/testing. Consider adding a dev-only 'skip prefetch' flag or honoring a ?skipAudio=1 query param to make the demo deterministic in tests.

KoolliteROIPage.jsx passes ctaHref="/lighting" to KoolliteDualPath inside the page (line 220), but the top-level CTAs on /koollite/roi go to /lighting and proposal flow — confirm this is intentional (task said /koollite/roi CTA should likely link users onward to proposal/Lighting Engine, which is fine).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Koollite Dual-Path feature is fully wired and working on: /koollite/roi (+/koollite, /roi, /lighting/roi aliases all render KoolliteROIPage), HomePage (home-koollite-dual-path-section with option-a/-b), /lighting (lighting-dual-path-section + DualPathSummary in proposal result), /demo/school (close gate modal school-demo-gate-close, then click school-demo-scene-btn-koollite — shows school-koollite-option-a/b/cta with cta.href=/koollite/roi), /demo/supermarket (click Start Demo, then scene-jump value=13 — shows supermarket-koollite-strip + supermarket-koollite-dualpath). For /demo/airport, the Start Demo button ('start-airport-demo-btn') is gated by audio prefetch (can take 30-60s). Once started, use 'airport-control-jump' value=5 to reach the Lifecycle scene where airport-koollite-dualpath-wrap + airport-koollite-dualpath appear after ImpactTiles — the testids exist in AirportDemoPage.jsx lines 1316-1319 (code review confirmed). Input-change reactivity is confirmed: changing the fixtures input on /koollite/roi re-computes both koollite-roi-supermarket-result-a and -result-b text content. All 4 preset buttons rewire the dual-path block via key={preset.id} remount. The proposal-dual-path-summary block (lines 682-725 of LightingUpgradeEnginePage) was not exercised (requires real email + proposal generation); the testids proposal-dual-path-summary, proposal-dualpath-option-a, proposal-dualpath-option-b, proposal-dual-path-cta are confirmed present in source.
rca of the issue: One non-blocking React hydration warning on /lighting: a <span> is rendered inside <option> (HTML spec forbids this). Likely due to a wrapper component used for option children. Fix at /app/frontend/src/pages/LightingUpgradeEnginePage.jsx line ~290 — render the option's label as a plain string, not a <span>.
